item.title: How do phone keyboards and typing work?
item.description: Phone keyboards use capacitive touchscreen sensors to detect finger touches on glass, converting them into text without physical keys. Modern smartphone typing combines touch detection technology, autocorrect algorithms, and machine learning-powered predictive text to deliver fast, accurate typing experiences. item.title: What is the difference between phone screen timeout settings?
item.description: Phone screen timeout settings determine how long your display stays active before automatically turning off. Understanding the differences between timeout durations—from 15 seconds to 10 minutes—helps you balance battery conservation, security, and convenience. Shorter timeouts maximize battery life but may interrupt reading, while longer settings offer comfort at the cost of power consumption. Most users find 1-2 minutes ideal for daily use, though your perfect setting depends on usage patterns

item.title: What are the basics of phone voice assistants?
item.description: Phone voice assistants are AI-powered software that respond to spoken commands, helping you control your smartphone hands-free. They use voice recognition and natural language processing to understand requests, then execute tasks like sending messages, setting reminders, or searching the web. Most modern smartphones include built-in voice assistants that make everyday tasks quicker and more convenient, whether you're driving, cooking, or multitasking.
